title: Draftsman
description:
Civil Draftsman required to prepare 2D/3D drawings, site layouts, plans, elevations and sections using AutoCAD. Coordinate with engineers, update drawings and maintain records. Diploma/ITI in Civil Draftsmanship. 2–5 years’ experience preferred.

Key Skills: AutoCAD Drafting,Civil Engineering,AutoCAD 2D,AutoCAD Drawing,AutoCAD,Draftsman activities,Drawing,Draw
